snippet.title: Mia & Mio: The Last Witch  |   Reveal Trailer  |   Soon to launch on Kickstarter!
snippet.description:
A narrative-driven 2D top-down game featuring simple yet engaging mechanics. Fans of story-rich RPGs, point-and-click adventures, visual novels, and cozy titles will appreciate Mia & Mio: The Last Witch. 

Dont miss the Kickstarter lauch: 
www.thelastwitch.net
